contract.authentication: existing_local_credential_and_workspace_context_for_reads_exact_source_authority_and_client_pairing; operator_database_login_for_init; the query host's service-user configuration for broker commands

client_pairing.result_envelope: available receipt, unavailable reason or failed reason
client_pairing.secret_delivery: a new caller-named owner-only file created exclusively before the database call; the secret is never printed, logged or accepted as input; the file is removed when pairing is refused or fails before committing, and kept with the derived principal and pairing grant identifiers reported as pairing_outcome_unknown when a lost connection leaves the commit unknown

doctor.--check-database: read-only reachability, schema compatibility and login role readiness; never migrates, grants or repairs; schema_compatibility is compatible, mismatch, unknown, not_installed or unverified; an application login cannot read the owner-only migration history, so it reports unverified with database_check login_ready_schema_unverified, never a full pass
doctor.default: configuration only; no database or model

initialization.authority: operator database login that can assume the application role; once per database
initialization.result_envelope: available receipt, unavailable reason or failed reason
initialization.secret_delivery: a new caller-named owner-only file created exclusively before the database call; never printed, logged or accepted as input; removed when nothing commits or on replay; kept and reported as initialization_outcome_unknown when a lost connection leaves the commit unknown

query_host.client: MEMORIESQL_RESULTS_SOCKET selects the local trusted query host for query, result, inspect, source and relations; the client presents only its own paired credential and workspace over a Unix socket whose serving uid it verifies, and never uses a database URL
query_host.direct: without the socket, query and result compose the trusted executor in-process and need the host's own database logins, which are never given to an agent
query_host.operator: broker serve|provision|check|runs|cleanup|close-run run only as the host's service user with its private configuration; each prints one JSON line and exits 0, 2 or 3; serve runs the expired-result cleanup at start and hourly, and cleanup runs it once

paired_agent_reads.inspect: owner_only: the exact stored-bead readers answer resource_unavailable to paired agents
paired_agent_reads.relations: owner_only: the exact stored-bead readers answer resource_unavailable to paired agents
paired_agent_reads.source: owner_only: the exact stored-bead readers answer resource_unavailable to paired agents
paired_agent_reads.source_citation: through query results: the normalized text of authorized source units in memory_v1.source_units under memory.query and source.read; never raw bytes or clause-level citations

results.query: QueryRequest (discover|enumerate, resolved|historical view) through a trusted executor; closed reply printed unchanged
results.result: ReuseRequest with the exact result_id and content_digest pin, optional cursor
results.run: one persisted run per principal and workspace in an owner-only state file; rotated before expiry; --new-run; never retried
results.schema: installed logical catalog, prepared/reserved/not-prepared relations, admission rules and delivery limits; no database or run
results.trusted_host: control login, reviewed restricted reader and optional pinned profile hash, configured only in a credential-isolated process; otherwise trusted_query_host_not_configured

source_authority.result_envelope: available receipt, unavailable reason or failed reason

summary: One public executable with contract catalog, configuration health, authorized stored reads, exact provider-neutral source authority, one-time personal-local initialization, local agent client pairing and governed query/result reuse through a trusted executor; no private routing claim.
